title: 法兴银行：去杠杆进程未结束，半导体利润率接近历史高位
speaker: Frank Benzimra

segments.en: Well, first of all, we are looking at where we are in the deleveraging process. And to look at that, we are looking number one, what kind of AM we have in the leverage ETF, what kind of outflow we have, and we start to see some outflow in the leverage ETF on the single stock.
segments.zh: 首先，我们关注去杠杆进程。观察杠杆ETF的资金流向，已开始出现个股杠杆ETF的资金流出。

segments.en: And we look at what kind of margin call do we see as a percentage of the total margin. So all these indicators are giving us some indication, just indication where we are in the deleveraging process. And probably we are well advanced in the deleveraging process, but we are not yet done.
segments.zh: 同时观察追加保证金占保证金总额的比例。这些指标显示去杠杆已进行较深，但尚未完成。

segments.en: And I think we need also to look at where we stand in the cycle. Now you look at the flash memory name, whether it is in the US or in Korea, you are close to 80% margin, so which is a historical high, which is higher than NVIDIA than other name. And then you need to wonder whether those margin are sustainable.
segments.zh: 还需审视周期位置。闪存公司无论在美国还是韩国，利润率接近80%，创历史新高，甚至超过英伟达。需要思考这种利润率能否持续。

segments.en: And to bear in mind that these markets are still cyclical market and there is still a cycle, and it's starting to back now. The broader backdrop here is, I mean, a way from memory, but there's also been a similar sell-off in the US chip space. Where do you think we are on that correction?
segments.zh: 要记住这些市场仍是周期性市场，周期正在转向。此外，美国芯片板块也出现了类似抛售。你认为调整到了什么阶段？
